tool.name: OGS: reviseMesh
tool.command: ln -sf '$input_mesh_file' 'input_mesh_file.vtu'; reviseMesh #if str($min_ele_dim) --min-ele-dim '$min_ele_dim' #end if #if str($eps) --eps '$eps' #end if --input-mesh-file 'input_mesh_file.vtu' --output-mesh-file output_1.vtu

param.label: min ele dim
param.help: Minimum dimension of elements to be inserted into new mesh

param.label: eps
param.help: Minimum distance for nodes not to be collapsed

tool.help: Revises meshes by collapsing duplicate nodes, (optionally) removing elements of lower dimension than the mesh itself, and subdividing geometrically broken mesh elements.
